title: Last Week, Last Month, Last Year: the Past
label: ch:ja-last-week-last-month-last-year-the-past
canDo: I can say what I did and did not do, and when: last week, last month, last year, a moment ago.

payoff.summary: Say what you did and did not do with -mashita and -masen deshita, placing each with senshuu, sengetsu, kyonen or sakki, and end with owarimashita.
